answer: Pay agents through vesting with clawback. Rewards earned each epoch drip out over 30 days, like a garden that only yields after a full season. If auditors later map a cluster of accounts onto one operator, using an atlas of linked funding and timing trails, every unvested reward in that cluster is clawed back. A farm of 200 clones earning 5 tokens a day each would forfeit about 30,000 tokens once caught, so there is no quick bridge from faking to profit.
